tests.test: Full suite 191 tests: all pass (new file 12 offset tests pass). Frontend not browser-driven.

design_decisions.decision: Offset above bigint max returns 422 via le= bound; rejected clamping to return [] silently.
Single-page state: both buttons shown but disabled; rejected hiding them.
Create calls loadPage(0) directly rather than setting currentPage first, so a failed load never changes the page number.
Step-back on empty page implemented generically inside loadPage (page>0 and empty), not only after delete.
